headword: {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}

definitions.explanation: Selling goods or services by visiting people's homes; often associated with high-pressure sales, and regulated by consumer law.

examples.japanese: {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{断|ことわ}りです。
{訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}わされた。
examples.english: I was pressured into buying an expensive futon from a door-to-door salesman.

examples.japanese: {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ならクーリング⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you sign a contract through door-to-door sales, you can cancel it under the cooling-off rule within a set period.

notes:
Many homes put up stickers saying {訪問販売|ほうもんはんばい}お{断|ことわ}り. Contracts made this way can be cancelled within a cooling-off period (クーリング⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧, eight days for most door-to-door sales).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{通信販売|つうしんはんばい}→通信販売：22846_tsuushinhanbai⟧: mail-order or online sales
- {押|お}し{売|う}り: high-pressure selling at the door
- クーリング⟦オフ→オフ：10733_ofu⟧: the cooling-off period for cancelling a contract
